name: @equin/plugin-fields-date-format
description: How the app writes a date or a time: the Clock, Date order and Numeric dates settings (Settings → Config), and the one DateFormatter every surface formats with — useDateFormatter() in the browser, serverDateFormatter() on the server, createDateFormatter(prefs) for a pure function handed one. Its lint rule (date-format/no-raw-date-format) refuses toLocaleTimeString / toLocaleDateString / Date#toLocaleString / Intl.DateTimeFormat anywhere else.
